adversarialPass.method: Each of the 110 SAFE-ARCHIVE repos was re-checked by a skeptic instructed to REFUTE the archive verdict, with external-dependent search (gh/npm), namespace/URI dereferencing, data-uniqueness, and liveness re-tests.
adversarialPass.note: GitHub archive is non-destructive and reversible (repo stays readable, Pages/npm stay live), which is why npm-published melbot snapshots and PDF/asset repos still confirm.
